notes: Generated by tools/build-assets.mjs (recipe tools/assets/trna.mjs) from the mmCIF file pinned in tools/sources.lock.json (model 1, altloc . or A, no hydrogens, waters excluded).

Chain Z: 76 modelled nucleotides. Standard numbering = author number; a repeated author number gets the suffix A on its second residue (17A). label_seq_id -> standard number: label 1-16 = 2-17; label 17 = 17A; label 18-76 = 18-76.
No modified nucleotides: every residue of this chain is A, C, G or U in the entry.
Anticodon 34-36 = CAU (5' to 3'), pairs with mRNA codon AUG (7K00 chain X author 16-18).

trna frame (PLAN.md 7.3): origin = centroid of C1' of nucleotides 34-36; +z toward the P atom of nucleotide 76; +x = component of (centroid of all P atoms - origin) perpendicular to z; +y = z x x. Implemented by trnaFrame() in tools/assets/trna.mjs.

L0: one envelope per part (Gaussian density, sigma 3.5 A, requested spacing 2.5 A, actual spacing body 2.5, anticodon 2.5 A) of P atoms plus C4' and N9 (purine) or N1 (pyrimidine) of every nucleotide; L1 beads inside: body 0.959, anticodon 1 (all-points containment target raised from 0.95 until L1 beads reached 0.95: body 0.955, anticodon 0.95).
L1: one P bead per nucleotide.
L2 site acceptor (8 A): heavy atoms of whole nucleotides with any atom within 8 A of the acceptor anchor origin (O3' of nucleotide 76); nucleotides 75, 76.

acceptor anchor: o = O3' of the 3' nucleotide; z = unit(O3' - C3'); x = component of the trna +x perpendicular to z. elbow anchor: o = centroid of all heavy atoms of nucleotides 18, 19, 55, 56. center anchor: centroid of all P atoms. Rotations of center and elbow are the identity.
Span check: anticodon origin to P of nucleotide 76 = 76.147 A; PLAN.md 7.4 acceptance range 65-80 A: met.
Track anticodon: Kabsch-fitted standard base frames (tools/lib/frames.mjs) on 34-36, none synthetic. source.anticodonC1prime holds the observed C1' positions for tests.
